acceptance: Bare item preview and save default to quantity 1 and unit piece.
Requested count and package size remain separate.
Newest items appear first and shop filters remain visible and actionable.
Known items receive safe categories/shop tags and uncertain items remain Unassigned.
Autocomplete, spelling clarification, and household history remain local and reversible.
Natural-language capture, drafts, replay, undo, and context isolation survive restart.
Live and sandbox use fixed distinct ports, processes, and databases.
Only verified immutable releases can be approved for live.
External assistance is disabled by default and locally mocked in tests.
